source: Set only by the scheduled kotValidationThread fallback (ury_kot_validation.py) as "::". source: Stable per-line identity supplied by the POS client (cart uniqueId) and echoed back on reload. sync_order() diffs previous-vs-current order lines on this key, so a quantity change on an existing line is seen as a delta instead of a remove+add.
